opening.argument: The presentation promotes mining participation through paid package sales and a downline, stating that viewers “payed 1 Euro 20 in your package” and that selling a package to a downline means “you will mine the coin directly.” It presents early entry as an opportunity to make a fortune, using a time-limited split benefit, future-value comparisons, and claimed difficulty increases to encourage participation. It also links recruitment to price and value claims, asserting that “the more people who start mining the one coin, the higher the price of the coin in the market” and that “The more people come in the more valuable your coins become.”
